snippet.title: Mamorukun ReCurse! - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Descend into The Netherworld in this explosive cute ‘em up, where Curse Bullets let you adjust the challenge as you go! Mamorukun ReCurse! will be coming this year to Steam, Nintendo Switch, PS4 & PS5 and Xbox Series X|S! 

Follow Clear River Games on X for updates: http://www.x.com/clearrivergames
